description: Find the booked pallet mark that never reached the loaded list on a wharf despatch sheet. DISTILL-CANARY-e5ab820a

files.README.md:
Mellinow Wharf - despatch sheets

The loader works from one sheet per van. The office books the pallets before the
van arrives and the loader marks the ones that go on, so the two lines on the
sheet do not always hold the same marks.

turns.prompt: Mellinow Wharf booked six pallets for the morning van to Bristol and the loader marked the pallets that went on it. Which booked mark has no line on the loaded list? Report the mark exactly as the sheet writes it. Reply with only the final answer.
